name: VAT Output Status
query:
SELECT
    vom.name AS "VAT Output:Link/VAT Output Metadata:150",
    vom.noinvoice AS "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    vom.status AS "Status::100",
    vom.transactionid AS "Transaction ID::150",
    vom.nofa AS "No Faktur::120",
    vom.create_vat_response AS "API Response::200",
    vom.vat_upload_success AS "Upload Success:Check:100",
    vom.modified AS "Last Modified:Datetime:150"
FROM
    `tabVAT Output Metadata` vom
WHERE
    vom.docstatus = 0
ORDER BY
    vom.modified DESC
